title: Payment API HTTP 503 during payment processing
symptoms: HTTP 503 during payment processing; intermittent payment request failures.
workaround: Restart the affected service instance after confirming operational safety.

title: Customer portal login request timeout
symptoms: Login requests time out intermittently after credentials are submitted.
root_cause: Authentication service latency or saturated request workers
workaround: Check authentication service health and recent latency metrics.
resolution: Investigate authentication dependency latency and tune worker capacity if evidence supports it.

title: Storage service unavailable during file upload
symptoms: Uploads fail and storage is reported unavailable.
root_cause: Storage endpoint connectivity or service availability issue
workaround: Verify storage endpoint health and connectivity.
resolution: Restore storage connectivity and validate service health.
